verdict: Paid ads have been off since September 16 — relaunch is in motion.
narrative: All paid advertising stopped on September 16 and has not run since, meaning the 12 leads and $18.10 cost per lead shown in this period's totals reflect activity before that cutoff — the last 26 days produced zero paid leads. Several planned setup milestones passed their September 30 deadline unfinished, which is what is holding the restart: conversion tracking, landing pages, and creative assets are all being completed now. Your Google Business Profile is active and drew 55 direction requests this period, but is producing zero calls — the phone contact option appears broken and is being fixed this week. Website sessions dropped roughly 43% in the most recent days, likely reflecting the absence of paid traffic rather than an organic problem. Once the overdue items are cleared, paid campaigns will relaunch and session volume is expected to recover with them.
